response.sql: WITH item_town AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city AS town, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), town_averages AS (SELECT town, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM item_town GROUP BY town), cross_town AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM town_averages) SELECT t.town, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - x.avg_ratio AS ratio_above_average FROM town_averages AS t CROSS JOIN cross_town AS x WHERE t.avg_ratio > x.avg_ratio

assumptions.assumption: Missing towns are excluded, and a zero derived_total_cost gives a missing ratio.
